prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重点城市季度GDP增速对比表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "季度增速（%）" spans 4 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "季度增速（%） › 一季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "季度增速（%） › 二季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "季度增速（%） › 三季度" · longest unbreakable word 23px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "季度增速（%） › 四季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 766px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较六个重点城市四个季度的GDP增速，并结合说明理解各城市的变化背景。","reading":"读者先按行查看同一城市的季度变化，也会沿季度列比较城市；说明文字提供背景，通常在数值比较之后阅读。","groups":["第一列城市名称是行标识，应与同一行的数值和说明保持清晰对应。","第二至第五列都是季度增速，作用相同，应保持一致的宽度和节奏，方便横向及纵向比较。","第六列说明是较长的连续文字，需要更多宽度，并可利用数据行的高度自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称和季度增速数值应保持完整，不拆分。","尽量保持各季度子表头完整；总表头应清楚覆盖四个季度列。"],"may_wrap":["说明文字可按中文语义自然换行；各行已有的说明换行高度可容纳其他单元格的换行。","在优先为说明分配空间的方案中，季度子表头可以换行，但会增加表头高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [55, 67, 67, 67, 67, 396] · table 720×454px · row heights [36, 36, 83, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [59, 80, 80, 80, 80, 340] · table 720×524px · row heights [36, 36, 83, 83, 60, 60, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [52, 62, 62, 62, 62, 419] · table 720×454px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"城市名、季度表头和数值均保持完整；四个等宽季度列便于横向查看和纵向比较。说明占据主要宽度，除首行外均为两行，整体紧凑。","problems":"上海行的说明末尾只有“接。”，形成很短的第三行，也使首行明显高于其余数据行。季度列刚好容纳表头，节奏清楚，但说明区仍略显局促。","cause":"说明列为396px，扣除内边距和边框后，首行文字恰好放不进两行；四个67px季度列已接近完整显示46px表头所需的下限。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"季度列宽敞且等宽，表头和数值完整，列间边界易于辨认。","problems":"季度数值周围留白过多，而说明频繁换成三行，部分末行很短；数据行高低交替，表格明显拉长，削弱了同一城市各项信息的整体感。","cause":"四个季度列各占80px，比完整显示表头所需宽度更宽；说明列因此缩至340px，导致更多换行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"说明列较宽，六行说明都控制在两行，数据行高度一致，行与行之间的对应关系清楚；城市名和数值保持完整。","problems":"四个季度表头都把“季度”拆开，读者需要跨行辨认，表头区也因此增高；紧窄的季度列使数字区显得拥挤。","cause":"每个季度列只有62px，扣除21px后不足以容纳约46px的完整表头；增加的说明宽度以表头完整性为代价。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整表头优先","widths":[52,67,67,67,67,399],"change":"城市列收至完整容纳名称所需的52px，季度列维持完整表头的最小宽度67px，其余空间给说明。检查增加3px后首行短尾是否改善，同时保留清晰的季度表头。"},{"name":"均匀行高优先","widths":[52,65,65,65,65,407],"change":"在r0C和r0A之间折中，季度列各增加3px，说明列保留较大宽度；检验能否维持各说明两行，并观察稍宽的季度表头换行是否更易读。"}]}
